description:
Create, play back and print beautiful sheet music with free and easy to use music notation software MuseScore.


MuseScore Studio 4.7.6 is now available!
This update adds options to convert PDFs, audio, or YouTube videos to scores via MuseScore.com, as well as fixes for several bugs and crashes.
To learn more, see the full announcements for 4.7.6 and 4.7.
And don't forget to check out the 4.7 release video!
